text:
I often hesitate to upgrade my notification settings the moment a new update drops. While increased connectivity sounds appealing, the initial flood of alerts often triggers immediate digital burnout. 

By delaying the upgrade, I can observe my current workflow and decide which alerts actually earn my mental energy. It is better to distinguish useful data from persistent noise before everything starts pinging at once. Sometimes, the best notification is the one you never receive.
